lessons.title: Lesson 1: Allah
paragraphs: Let's begin together...
Allah...
Have you heard this name before?...
Let's take our time to remember...
You can tell me what you remember...
And let's say this name together...
Allah...
Now it's your turn to say this name...
Well done!...
We are starting with this name...
And each time, we will learn something new about Allah...

lessons.title: Lesson 2: We believe that Allah is One
paragraphs: We have learned this name...
Allah...
And today we learn that Allah is One...
Not two, and not three...
Let's hold up one finger...
Just one finger...
To help us remember the word "one"...
Well done!...
Now let's finish a sentence together...
I'll say the beginning...
And you say the last word...
We believe that Allah is...
One...
"We believe" means we accept it as true...
Now let's say the whole sentence together...
We believe that Allah is One...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Allah made me
paragraphs: Allah made us...
And gave us our bodies...
Today we will look at something we use a lot...
Our hands...
Let's look at our hands together...
Let's gently open them...
Then gently close them...
And open them again...
Well done!...
Now let's move our fingers...
Let's try moving one finger...
Then let's try moving the other fingers...
Well done!...
What can we do with our hands?...
Let's think of one thing...
We hold a cup with our hands...
And we hold our toys...
So who made our hands...
And made us able to move them?...
Allah...
We also have eyes to see with...
Let's look at something near us...
What can we see?...
You can say what you see...
Well done!...
Allah made our eyes that we see with...
And our ears that we hear with...
And our tongues and lips that we speak with...
We did not make ourselves...
Before we were born...
We were in our mothers' tummies...
And Allah is the One who made our bodies...
Then we were born...
And we began to grow, little by little...
Our bodies are blessings from Allah...
A blessing is something good that Allah gives us...
Like our hands, our eyes, and our ears...
Now let's choose a part of our body...
A hand, an eye, or an ear...
And think...
What do we do with it?...
If we choose an eye...
We remember that we see with it...
And we say...
Allah made my eye...
And you, what did you choose?...
Let's talk about what we chose...
Well done!...
And let's say together...
Allah made me...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Allah made what I see
paragraphs: We talked about our hands and our eyes...
Now let's remember something we saw outside our home...
Can we remember a tree?...
Or a bird?...
Or the sky above us?...
Let's choose one of them...
And say its name...
Let's take our time...
Well done!...
Allah made the tree...
And Allah made the bird...
And Allah made the sky too...
Let's imagine a bird spreading its wings...
Why does a bird need its wings?...
Let's think for a little while...
A bird flies with its wings...
And Allah is the One who made it...
And gave it its wings...
Let's also think about daytime and nighttime...
When does the sun shine for us?...
At night or in the daytime?...
The sun shines for us in the daytime...
And at night, it gets dark around us...
And we may see stars in the sky...
Allah made the sun and the stars...
And gave us night and day...
And made the earth we walk on...
Now it's your turn...
Let's name one of these things that Allah made...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Nothing is like Allah
paragraphs: Let's put our hands next to each other...
And look at them...
Well done!...
Can we see something that is the same in both hands?...
Let's think for a little while...
Each hand has fingers...
And each hand has a palm...
So we say...
One hand looks like another hand...
And one tree may look like another tree...
And one bird may look like another bird...
Let's think of two things that look like each other...
You can say what you remember...
Well done!...
These are things Allah made...
We call them creations...
That means things Allah made...
But Allah...
Is not like anything He made...
Allah is not like us...
Allah is the Creator...
That means He is the One who made us...
And made what is around us...
Let's look at our hands again...
Who made them?...
Allah...
Our hands are creations...
And Allah, who made us...
Is not like anything He made...

lessons.title: Lesson 6: We need Allah
paragraphs: Let's remember a time when we felt thirsty...
What do we need when we are thirsty?...
Water to drink?...
Or a toy to play with?...
Let's think...
Our bodies need water...
And let's move a hand...
As if we are holding a cup and drinking from it...
Well done!...
And when we are hungry...
What do we need?...
Food to eat...
And when we are tired...
We need rest and sleep...
Let's think about grown-ups...
Do they eat and drink too?...
Have you seen a grown-up drinking water?...
We need these things when we are little...
And we still need them when we grow up...
But Allah...
Does not need food...
Or water...
Or sleep...
Allah does not need anything...
And we always need Allah...
He made us...
And made the water and plants we need...
Let's name one thing our bodies need...
Well done!...
And let's remember...
We need Allah...

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Allah can do whatever He chooses
paragraphs: Let's think of the wide sky...
And a little leaf on a plant...
Which is bigger?...
The sky or the leaf?...
Let's think for a little while...
The sky is very wide...
We can move our hands a little farther apart...
And say...
The sky is wide...
Well done!...
Now let's bring them closer together...
And say...
The leaf is small...
Well done!...
Allah made the wide sky...
And He also made plants and their little leaves...
So making something big is not hard for Allah...
And making something small is not hard for Him either...
Allah is able...
That means He can do whatever He chooses...
Now it's your turn...
Can you remember an animal Allah made?...
And can you remember a plant?...
Let's name what we remember...
Well done!...
And remember that Allah is able to make these things...

lessons.title: Lesson 8: Allah provides for us
paragraphs: Let's think of a fruit we like to eat...
Which fruit do you choose?...
You can say the name of the fruit...
Well done!...
Some of our food grows in the ground...
Let's imagine a little plant...
What does it need to grow?...
Let's think for a little while...
It needs water...
Let's move our fingers...
A little downward...
As if they are drops of water falling...
Well done!...
Allah sends down rain...
And the water reaches the ground...
And Allah makes plants grow with the water...
So food grows for us to eat...
And trees grow with fruit on them...
And people work...
They plant...
And water...
And gather the food...
Then it reaches our homes...
And our families prepare it for us...
So who made the water and the plants...
And made people able to work?...
Allah...
This is something Allah gives us...
Allah gives us water to drink...
And food to eat...
And the bird we talked about...
Does it need food too?...
It looks for its food...
And Allah provides for it just as He provides for us...
Let's remember the fruit we chose...
We can say its name...
Then say...
This is something Allah gives us...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 9: Allah knows
paragraphs: We talked about the fruit we like...
Let's choose a fruit again...
But this time...
We only think of the word...
Without saying it out loud...
Let's take our time...
Well done!...
We can think of something...
Without speaking...
And Allah knows what we are thinking...
Even before we say it...
Now you can say the word you chose...
Well done!...
Let's think together...
Does Allah know the word...
While we are thinking of it without speaking?...
Allah knows what we are thinking...
And He knows what we say too...
And He knows everything about us...
He knows where we are...
And what happens to us...
And when we are happy or sad...
Let's think of something that makes us happy...
You can talk about it...
Well done!...
Allah knows how we feel too...
And even a leaf that falls from a tree...
If we do not see it...
Allah knows about it...
What we see and what we do not see...
Allah knows it all...

lessons.title: Lesson 10: Allah hears
paragraphs: We talked about a word we think of...
And learned that Allah knows what we are thinking...
Now let's say a short sentence...
I am here...
It's your turn...
Let's say it together...
I am here...
Well done!...
Allah hears what we say...
When we speak in our usual voices...
And when we speak quietly too...
We do not need to shout for Allah to hear us...
And let's think...
If we think of something...
And do not say it out loud...
Does Allah know it too?...
Yes...
Allah knows what we are thinking...
Even when we do not speak...
He hears what we say...
And knows what we are thinking...
Allah is the All-Hearing...
He hears all sounds...
And His hearing is not like ours...
He knows what we need...
And hears what we say...
So what do we say to Him when we need something?...
That is what we will learn together next time...

lessons.title: Lesson 11: I ask Allah
paragraphs: We learned that Allah hears what we say...
And knows what we need...
Let's remember...
What do we need when we are thirsty?...
Water...
And Allah is the One who gave us water...
And the food we eat...
And we can ask Allah for what we need...
Let's try together...
O Allah...
Give us water to drink...
Well done!...
We are asking Allah...
This is called dua...
When we make dua to Allah...
We ask Him for what we need...
And we also ask our families to give us water...
Allah has given us families who help us...
Now let's choose something we need...
Water to drink?...
Or food to eat?...
You can ask Allah for what you chose...
We say, "O Allah..."
Then we ask Him for what we need...
Well done!...
Allah hears our dua...

lessons.title: Lesson 12: I ask Allah to keep me safe
paragraphs: Let's remember going out with our families...
When we cross the road...
We hold the hand of a grown-up in our family...
Can you remember who holds your hand?...
You can say who you remember...
Well done!...
Our families help us...
And we ask Allah to keep us safe...
That means to protect us from things that can hurt us...
Let's say together...
O Allah, keep me safe...
Well done!...
And we can also say...
I ask Allah to protect me...
That means I ask Allah to keep me safe...
Let's say it together...
I ask Allah to protect me...
Well done!...
Now let's think of our families...
We love them...
And we want Allah to keep them safe too...
Let's make dua for ourselves and for them...
O Allah, keep me and my family safe...
Well done!...
We stay close to our families...
And ask Allah to protect us...

lessons.title: Lesson 13: I thank Allah
paragraphs: Let's think of a food we like...
What food did you think of?...
You can say its name...
Well done!...
This food is something Allah gives us...
Allah is the One who gave us water...
And made plants grow for us...
And gave us our bodies too...
When we remember what Allah has given us...
We thank Him...
One way we thank Him is to say...
All praise is for Allah...
We say it while we remember Allah's blessings...
Let's say it together...
All praise is for Allah...
Well done!...
Now let's choose another blessing...
Our eyes that we see with?...
Or our ears that we hear with?...
You can say what you chose...
Then let's say together...
All praise is for Allah...
Well done!...
And when someone in our family prepares food for us...
We thank them for their help...
And praise Allah, who gave us the food...
This is how we remember Allah in our day...

lessons.title: Lesson 14: I love Allah
paragraphs: Let's think of a sound we like to hear...
Our mother's voice?...
Or the voice of someone in our family?...
What sound did you think of?...
Well done!...
Allah gave us our ears that we hear with...
And our eyes that we see with...
And He made us and gave us what we need...
And He hears our dua...
Whenever we remember these blessings...
We remember Allah, who gave them to us...
And we love Allah...
Let's say together...
I love Allah...
Well done!...
And because we love Allah...
We want to do what He loves...
Like helping our families...
Let's think of a little way to help...
What could we do?...
We could put our toys back where they belong...
That makes it easier for our families to tidy our home...
And you can name another way to help...
Well done!...
We love Allah...
And we want to do what He loves...

lessons.title: Lesson 15: We worship Allah alone
paragraphs: Let's remember what we learned...
When we need something...
We make dua to Allah...
And when we remember what He has given us...
We say, "All praise is for Allah..."
Let's choose one of these...
A dua we can make to Allah...
Or a blessing we can praise Him for...
And say what we chose...
Well done!...
We ask Allah...
And praise Him and thank Him...
We do this for Allah...
Because we love Him and want to obey Him...
That means doing what He tells us to do...
And not doing what He tells us not to do...
These are ways of worshiping Allah...
And Allah is the only One we worship...
He is the One who made us and gave us what we need...
And no one is like Him...
Let's finish a sentence together...
We worship Allah...
Alone...
Now let's say it all...
We worship Allah alone...
Well done!...
Prayer is also a way we worship Allah...
And we will learn about it together...

lessons.title: Lesson 16: Muslims pray to Allah
paragraphs: Have you seen someone in your family praying?...
You can tell me what you remember...
Well done!...
When Muslims pray...
They are worshiping Allah...
In prayer they remember Allah and make dua to Him...
Prayer has words and actions that we learn...
One of these is standing...
Let's try standing quietly...
For a little while...
Well done!...
Standing is a part of prayer...
And we learn its other actions and words with our families...
Step...
By step...
Let's think...
Who do Muslims pray to?...
Allah...
We pray to Allah, who made us...
And we love Him and worship Him...
We can also ask someone in our family to teach us...
Let's practice asking...
I would like to learn to pray with you...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 17: When I do something wrong, I turn back to Allah
paragraphs: Sometimes we do something wrong...
Like taking our friend's toy...
When they have not said we can take it...
Then we realize we did something wrong...
And wish we had not done it...
So what can we do now?...
Let's think...
We stop doing what is wrong...
And give the toy back to our friend...
Because it is their toy...
And we say to them...
I am sorry...
Let's practice saying it...
I am sorry...
Well done!...
And we do not want to take other people's things...
Without them saying we can...
And we ask Allah to forgive us...
So we say...
O Allah, forgive me...
Let's say it together...
O Allah, forgive me...
Well done!...
We stop doing what is wrong...
And put right what we did...
And ask Allah to forgive us...
This is how we turn back to Allah...
This is called turning back to Allah...
Allah accepts it when someone turns back to Him...
Now let's remember the toy...
If we want to play with our friend's toy again...
What do we do before we take it?...
We ask them...
May I play with it?...
Let's try saying this sentence...
Well done!...
And we play with it if they say we can...
We learn from our mistake...
And turn back to Allah...

lessons.title: Lesson 18: The Quran is from Allah
paragraphs: Today we are learning about the Quran...
Have you heard this word before?...
The Quran is Allah's words...
Allah gave us the Quran so we can learn from it...
And the book with the Quran written in it...
Is called a mushaf...
We can ask our families to show us a mushaf...
Let's practice asking...
I would like to see the mushaf...
Well done!...
And if there is a mushaf near us...
We can look at its pages with our families...
The words of the Quran are on these pages...
And when someone reads the Quran...
They are reading Allah's words...
And we can listen to the Quran and learn it...
Let's finish this together...
The Quran is the words of...
Allah...
Let's say the whole sentence...
The Quran is Allah's words...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 19: The Quran teaches me what to do
paragraphs: We learned about the Quran...
And learned that it is Allah's words...
So what do we learn from the Quran?...
Let's find out together...
The Quran teaches us to worship Allah alone...
And to be good to our mothers and fathers...
That means helping them...
And speaking kindly to them...
Let's think of an example...
If our mother needs a book that is near us...
What could we do?...
We could give her the book...
And the Quran teaches us to say kind things to people...
Let's think of someone who helped us...
What could we say to them?...
Thank you...
Let's try saying it...
Thank you...
Well done!...
The Quran guides us...
That means it teaches us what Allah loves, so we can do it...
Now let's choose something we will do today...
Help someone in our family?...
Or say something kind to someone?...
You can say what you chose...
Well done!...
We learn from the Quran...
Then we do what we learned...

lessons.title: Lesson 20: Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, may Allah bless him and give him peace
paragraphs: We learned that the Quran is from Allah...
And Allah sent a messenger to teach people...
His name is Muhammad...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
What does it mean that he is a messenger from Allah?...
It means Allah chose him from among the people...
And sent him to teach them what Allah told them to do...
So he used to read the Quran to them...
And teach them how to worship Allah...
Let's remember prayer...
Who do Muslims pray to?...
Allah...
And Allah's Messenger...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
Is the one who taught them to pray...
And taught them to worship Allah alone...
Let's say together...
Muhammad is Allah's Messenger...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
... Well done!...
When we say, "May Allah bless him and give him peace"...
We are asking Allah to speak well of our Prophet Muhammad among the angels, and to honor him...

We love Allah's Messenger Muhammad...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
And we want to learn what he taught people...

lessons.title: Lesson 21: Allah sent messengers
paragraphs: Allah sent Muhammad...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
And before him, He sent other messengers...
One was a messenger named Noah...
Peace be upon him...
Allah sent him to his people...
That means the people he lived among...
To call them to worship Allah...
That means to teach them to worship Allah...
And one was a messenger named Moses...
Peace be upon him...
Allah sent him too...
Let's remember the two names...
Noah, peace be upon him...
And Moses, peace be upon him...
You can choose one of them and say his name...
Well done!...
Who sent these messengers?...
Allah...
Allah's messengers taught people to worship Allah alone...
And to obey Him...
That means doing what He told them to do...
Let's remember what we say too...
We worship Allah alone...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 22: We do what Allah's messengers taught us
paragraphs: We learned that Allah sent messengers to teach people...
So what do we do with what we learn from them?...
Let's try an example...
Allah's Messenger...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
Taught us to say Allah's name before we eat...
So we say...
In Allah's name...
We begin our meal by saying Allah's name...
Let's say it together...
In Allah's name...
Well done!...
And he taught us to eat with our right hand...
Let's find our right hand...
Someone in our family can help us...
And when we know which one it is, we point to it...
Well done!...
And the next time we eat...
What will we say before we begin?...
In Allah's name...
And which hand do we eat with?...
Our right hand...
This is how we do what we learned...
And this is what it means to follow what Allah's Messenger taught us...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
We learn from him...
Then we do what he taught us...

lessons.title: Lesson 23: The two statements of faith
paragraphs: Let's remember two things we learned...
Who do we worship?...
We worship Allah alone...
And who is the messenger who taught us the Quran?...
Muhammad is Allah's Messenger...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
And today we say the two statements of faith...
We begin with the words "I bear witness"...
That means I say this and I believe it...
Let's say the first statement together...
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah...
Well done!...
That means worship is for Allah alone...
So we worship Allah...
And do not worship anyone else...
Now let's say the second statement...
And I bear witness that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger...
Well done!...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...
We believe that Allah sent him...
And we believe what he told us about Allah...
And we learn from him how to worship Allah...
Let's say the two statements together...
Slowly...
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah...
And I bear witness that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger...
Well done!...
And we say about Allah's Messenger...
May Allah bless him and give him peace...

lessons.title: Lesson 24: Allah is merciful
paragraphs: We have learned many things about Allah...
Let's remember some of them together...
Allah made us...
And gave us our hands and our eyes...
And gave us water and food...
Let's choose something Allah gave us...
What did you choose?...
And what do you do with it?...
If we choose water...
We remember that we drink it when we are thirsty...
Now it's your turn to talk about what you chose...
Well done!...
And Allah is the One who keeps us safe...
So we ask Him to protect us...
Can you remember our dua?...
O Allah, keep me safe...
And we learned what to do when we do something wrong...
We stop doing what is wrong...
And put right what we did...
And ask Allah to forgive us...
And Allah accepts it when we turn back to Him...
And Allah gave us the Quran too...
To teach us what He loves...
And how to worship Him...
He gave us what we need...
And kept us safe...
And taught us...
And accepts us turning back to Him...
These are ways Allah shows us His mercy...
Allah is merciful...
Let's say together...
Allah is merciful...
Well done!...
Now let's remember one of these examples...
Something Allah gave us...
Or something He taught us...
You can talk about it...
Well done!...
This is Allah's mercy...
And let's praise Him together...
All praise is for Allah...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 25: We treat people kindly
paragraphs: We learned that the Quran teaches us what to do...
And today we learn how to treat people...
Let's think about playtime...
If we are playing...
And a child comes and wants to play with us...
What could we do?...
We could make room for them...
And say...
Would you like to play with us?...
Let's try saying it...
Would you like to play with us?...
Well done!...
Let's choose a game we know...
That we could play with our friend...
What did you choose?...
Well done!...
And while we play...
We pay attention to the person next to us...
So we do not push them with our hands...
Or hurt them...
And if their toy falls near us...
How could we help?...
We could pick it up and give it to them...
This is how we treat them kindly...
We help them...
And play with them without hurting them...

lessons.title: Lesson 26: We are good to our families
paragraphs: Let's think of someone in our family...
Who helps us get dressed...
Or covers us when we sleep...
Who did you think of?...
Well done!...
The Quran taught us to be good to our mothers and fathers...
And to our families...
So we help them...
And speak kindly to them...
Let's think of a little way to help...
If someone in our family is sitting down to rest...
And needs a cushion that is near us...
What could we do?...
We could bring the cushion closer to them...
And ask...
Where shall I put it?...
Let's say this question together...
Where shall I put it?...
Well done!...
And when someone in our family is sleeping...
We could choose quiet play...
So they can rest...
Now let's think of our families...
How could we help today?...
You can say your idea...
Well done!...
We love our families...
And treat them kindly...

lessons.title: Lesson 27: We help and give
paragraphs: Let's think of someone who helped us...
What did they do to help?...
Well done!...
And we can help too...
Let's think of an example...
If our friend is looking for their shoe...
How could we help?...
We look with them...
And if we see their shoe...
We point it out to them...
That means showing them where the shoe is...
We can help when we are little too...
We can do something small...
And we can give too...
Allah gave us food...
And there are people who need food...
We can get food ready for them with our families...
Let's think of a food we could share...
What did you choose?...
Well done!...
We can say to our families...
I would like to help you get the food ready...
Let's try saying it...
Well done!...
We help in the ways we can...
And give some of what Allah has given us...

lessons.title: Lesson 28: We speak kindly
paragraphs: We can help with our hands...
And we can say kind things too...
Let's think of a little example...
If someone speaks to us...
And we do not hear them clearly...
What could we say?...
I did not hear you clearly...
Please say it again...
Let's try saying it in a kind voice...
I did not hear you clearly...
Please say it again...
Well done!...
And if someone asks us for something...
And we cannot give it to them...
We can answer kindly...
I'm sorry, I can't right now...
Let's practice saying it...
I'm sorry, I can't right now...
Well done!...
And we do not laugh at how someone looks...
Or say things that hurt them...
The Quran taught us to say kind things to people...
Now let's choose a sentence to say today...
A sentence to ask for something kindly...
Or to answer someone kindly...
Let's try saying what we chose...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 29: We tell the truth
paragraphs: Let's look at something in front of us...
What do you see?...
You can say what you see...
Well done!...
If we see a ball...
We say, "I see a ball..."
And if we see a book...
We say, "I see a book..."
We say what we see, just as it is...
And when we tell what happened...
We tell it just as it happened...
This is part of telling the truth...
Let's think of another example...
If we spill water on the table by accident...
Then someone in our family asks...
What happened?...
What do we say?...
We say what happened...
I spilled the water...
And ask for help...
Can you help me wipe it up?...
Let's practice saying this...
I spilled the water...
Can you help me wipe it up?...
Well done!...
Now let's remember something we did today...
What did you do?...
You can talk about what happened...
Well done!...
We learn to tell the truth...
In what we say every day...

lessons.title: Lesson 30: We give everyone what is theirs
paragraphs: Let's imagine we are sitting with our friend...
And someone in our family puts two pieces of bread in front of us...
And says...
This one is for you...
And this one is for your friend...
Who do we give the second piece to?...
Our friend...
Because it is their piece...
We give them the whole piece...
And do not take any of it without their permission...
That means without them saying we can...
Let's try together...
As if we are giving them their piece...
And saying...
This is for you...
Well done!...
We each get what belongs to us...
This is part of being fair...
Now let's think about playing...
If we agree to take turns...
That means one of us plays...
Then the other plays...
What do we do when our turn is over?...
We let our friend have their turn...
Let's say...
It's your turn now...
Well done!...
We like to have what is ours...
And we give others what is theirs too...

lessons.title: Lesson 31: We learn to be patient
paragraphs: We learned to let our friend have their turn to play...
But we might want to play now...
So what do we do when they are not finished yet?...
We wait for our turn...
And do not take the toy from their hand...
Let's try waiting a little while together...
Well done!...
Waiting can be hard sometimes...
And we can ask our families to help us...
And here is another example...
When we help put the toys away...
It may take some time...
We put one toy back where it belongs...
Then another toy...
Until we finish helping...
And if there is a toy near us that needs putting away...
Let's try...
Putting it back where it belongs...
Well done!...
This may be a little hard...
But we try to finish helping...
This is another way to be patient...
And we ask Allah to help us...
Let's say together...
O Allah, help me be patient...
Well done!...
And if we find something hard...
We ask Allah to help us...
And ask for help...
And keep going, step by step...

lessons.title: Lesson 32: Zakat
paragraphs: Have you seen your family buying food?...
We pay money to buy what we need...
Let's remember something we bought with our families...
What did you think of?...
Well done!...
And there are people who do not have enough money...
To buy their food...
Or the clothes they need...
These are some of the people who are poor...
And Allah has told some Muslims to give part of their money...
And told them how much to give...
And who to give it to...
This giving is called zakat...
A Muslim learns when they must give zakat...
And gives it as Allah told them to...
And some of the people who receive zakat...
Are the poor people we talked about...
Let's think of a family who needs food...
And does not have enough money to buy it...
If they receive some zakat money...
What could they buy with it?...
They could buy food...
Let's name a food they could buy...
Well done!...
This is how zakat reaches those who have a right to it...
And we remember that Allah is the One who gave us what we have...
So we obey Him in how we use what He has given us...
Let's say together...
All praise is for Allah...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 33: Ramadan and fasting
paragraphs: Have you heard the word Ramadan before?...
Ramadan is a month that comes every year...
And Allah has told Muslims to fast in Ramadan...
So what does someone who is fasting do?...
They do not eat or drink...
From dawn...
That means the start of the morning, before the sun comes up...
Until the sun goes down...
And they do this to worship Allah...
Let's think together...
When the sun has gone down...
What can someone who is fasting do?...
They can eat and drink...
Because it is time to break the fast...
And Allah allows some people not to fast...
Like people who are ill and people who are traveling...
And you are still little...
So you do not have to fast now...
You can eat and drink in the daytime...
And learn about fasting with your family...
And we can help get the food ready for breaking the fast...
Let's choose a little way to help...
Shall we put napkins on the table?...
Or tidy the place with our families?...
What did you choose?...
Well done!...
We can tell our families how we would like to help...
Let's try...
I would like to help get the food ready for breaking the fast...
Well done!...
And in Ramadan, we listen to the Quran...
And make dua to Allah...
And remember that fasting is a way to worship Allah...

lessons.title: Lesson 34: The Kaaba and Hajj
paragraphs: Today we learn about a place called Makkah...
In Makkah there is a building called the Kaaba...
Have you seen a picture of the Kaaba before?...
We can ask our families to show us a picture of it...
Let's try asking...
I would like to see a picture of the Kaaba...
Well done!...
And if the picture is in front of us...
We can find the Kaaba in it with help from our families...
Then point to it...
Well done!...
Muslims go to Makkah from different places...
To do Hajj for Allah...
Hajj has a set time...
And things Muslims learn how to do...
One of these is tawaf around the Kaaba...
That means going around it to worship Allah...
And they make dua to Allah...
And remember Him...
Let's remember...
Who do Muslims do Hajj for?...
Allah...
We worship Allah alone...
In Makkah and everywhere...
And here, we can make dua to Allah for them...
What would you like to ask Allah for them?...
We can ask Him to keep them safe...
Let's say together...
O Allah, keep them safe...
Well done!...
They make dua to Allah in Makkah...
And we make dua to Him here...
And Allah hears all our dua...

units.title: Unit 6, the last unit: The angels and the next life

lessons.title: Lesson 35: Allah made the angels
paragraphs: Let's remember something Allah made...
A flower...
Or a cat...
Or something else you know...
What did you think of?...
Well done!...
And Allah made the angels too...
Allah told us about the angels in the Quran...
We do not see them now...
And we believe they are real...
Because we believe what Allah has told us...
And the angels obey Allah...
And do what He tells them to do...
Let's remember together...
Who made the angels?...
Well done!...
Allah made them...
And we are also learning how to obey Allah...
Let's ask Him to help us...
O Allah...
Help us do good...
Well done!...

lessons.title: Lesson 36: There is another life
paragraphs: What did you do today?...
Did you play?...
Or eat something you like?...
Or talk with someone in your family?...
Let's name one thing...
Well done!...
This life that we live now...
Is called our life in this world...
In it we eat and play...
And learn...
And worship Allah...
And our life in this world has an end...
And Allah has told us about another life...
That comes after this life...
It is called the next life...
Now let's remember...
Our life now is called life in this world...
So what is the other life called?...
Well done!...
The next life...
We believe in it...
Because Allah told us about it...

lessons.title: Lesson 37: Allah brings people back to life
paragraphs: We learned about the next life...
And today we learn something else Allah told us...
When a person's life in this world ends...
We call that death...
And Allah will bring people back to life after they die...
So they will be alive again...
Let's think together...
Who made us and gave us life?...
Well done!...
Allah made us...
And the One who made us...
Is able to bring us back to life...
This is called being brought back to life...
Let's say it together...
Being brought back to life...
Well done!...
When we say "being brought back to life"...
We mean that Allah gives people life again after they die...
So they live again...
Just as Allah told us...

lessons.title: Lesson 38: What we do matters
paragraphs: Let's imagine a little example...
Someone in our family drops a pen...
And we are next to them...
What could we do?...
We could pick the pen up from the floor...
And give it back to them...
And say...
Here you are...
Let's try saying these words...
Here you are...
Well done!...
A little bit of help...
And some kind words...
And Allah knows what we did...
And what we said...
Let's think...
If no one saw us helping...
Does Allah know about it?...
Yes...
Allah knows about it...
And in the next life...
Allah rewards good things we do...
Even when they are small...
So Allah does not let the good we do go to waste...
Let's choose a way we will help today...
Shall we put a book back where it belongs?...
Or help put the toys away?...
Or do you have another idea?...
Well done!...
We can help our families in the way we chose...

lessons.title: Lesson 39: Paradise
paragraphs: Today we learn about Paradise...
Paradise is a place in the next life...
And Allah has told us about beautiful things in it...
There are rivers...
And fruit...
And the people there are happy...
And hear kind words there...
Let's name one thing we learned about Paradise...
Well done!...
And the people in Paradise live there forever...
Their lives there do not end...
And Allah is merciful...
Can you remember a way Allah shows us His mercy?...
One way is that He gives us what we need...
And that He sent down the Quran for us...
And taught us how to do good...
And another way He shows His mercy...
Is that He brings into Paradise those who believe in Him...
And obey Him...
And do good...
And we believe in Allah...
And are learning how to obey Him...
And ask Him to bring us into Paradise by His mercy...
Let's make dua to Allah for ourselves and our families...
O Allah...
Bring us and our families into Paradise by Your mercy...
Well done!...
